title: Company bank account
summary: Companies incorporated through SPICe+ apply to open the company's bank account through the linked AGILE-PRO-S form; the chosen bank opens the account.

eligibility.text: All new companies incorporated through SPICe+ (w.e.f 23rd February2020) would also be mandatorily required to apply for opening the company's Bank account through the AGILE-PRO-S linked web form.

sources.title: FAQs on Incorporation and Allied Matters
Instruction Kit for Form No. SPICe + Part B

steps.title: Open the company's bank account
steps.description: Request the account through AGILE-PRO-S when filing SPICe+, choosing one of the integrated banks; the bank opens the account.

fee.note: No additional fee for applying through SPICe+.
